Spent remaining ~150 episodes (45-192) micro-optimizing video playback: creating delayed, lossless, and sharpened variants of the reference, tweaking frame alignment, comparing MAD/SSIM metrics.

Never returned to the algorithmic approach despite the instruction explicitly requiring it.
